title: Amazon shaman with a wife in the spirit world
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Amazon shaman with a wife in the spirit world, about unspecified at Amazon, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: shaman in the Amazon whose wife left him because of his wife in the spirit world

plain: An author named Graham Hancock, on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on a story about a shaman in the Amazon, meaning a traditional healer who works with spirits. According to Hancock, the shaman's real-world wife left him because he also had a wife in the spirit world. He tells it as a sign of how real that other world can feel to the people who visit it.
